name: Changeflow
summary: Hosted web-change monitoring with AI relevance filtering, sold to legal and compliance teams for regulatory intelligence: it watches pages the customer chooses (agency pages, the Federal Register, PDFs) and alerts on changes that match a plain-English brief. Hosted MCP server and REST API take a bearer token. Its free, keyless regulatory feed (GovPing) answered 410 Gone on 2026-11-11.

payments.notes: Read 2026-11-11: free tier with 3 sources; Professional $99/mo annual, hourly checks; Business $249/mo annual adds API access and webhooks; Enterprise custom with 10-minute checks. Payment method not read. Nothing prices a call.

agentAccess.notes: MCP at changeflow.com/mcp: keyless initialize answered 403 with a JSON-RPC error asking for a Bearer token, no OAuth metadata (2026-11-11). Same token as the REST API; the pricing page lists API access from the Business plan. 100 requests per hour per token.

jobs.summary: Watches customer-chosen regulator pages and alerts on changes matching a brief, with AI summaries; no mapping to policies. Claims an unnamed team caught 100% of relevant changes, no method. Lead time unmeasured; detection waits for the next check (hourly on paid plans).
